suppress.notes: CVE-2022-31691 (CVSS 9.8) affects the Spring Tools IDE plugins for Eclipse/VS Code (Snakeyaml in their YAML editors), not the spring-boot-devtools library. Matched only through a broad CPE. devtools is also <optional> and is excluded from the packaged JAR; Trivy reports app.jar clean.

CVE-2026-53914 (CVSS 9.8) is unsafe deserialization in the Kotlin compiler's build-cache metadata. This app only ships Kotlin runtime libraries (kotlin-stdlib, kotlin-stdlib-common, kotlin-reflect; transitive dependencies); no Kotlin compilation or build cache is involved at runtime. v1.1.1: widened from kotlin-stdlib* after the CI gate flagged kotlin-reflect.
CVE-2020-29582 (CVSS 5.3) was fixed in Kotlin 1.4.21 (2020). It matches kotlin-stdlib-common 1.9.10 only because the NVD CPE range is overly broad.
